newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles metro project receives U.S. funds.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles metro project receives U.S. funds.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Transit Administration released $84 million in federal funding for building the Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority's Metro Red Line, the transit agency said on Tuesday.
"This is another step in the commitment by the federal government to support us in the construction of the Metro Red Line system," Larry Zarian, MTA chairman, said.
With the additional money, the authority has received $439.9 million in federal participation for the project.
Zarian said the authority operated more than 47 miles of rail on the Metro Blue, Green, and Red Lines, and the number of passengers was rising.
